upstream.description: A 15TB Collection of Physics Simulation Datasets

classification.analysis: The Well is a 15TB collection of 16 numerical physics-simulation datasets (fluid dynamics, magnetohydrodynamics, acoustic scattering, biological systems, supernova/neutron-star mergers, etc.) packaged as a PyTorch-loadable Python library, plus benchmark surrogate-model training code (FNO and others) with Hydra-configured experiments and pretrained checkpoints on Hugging Face. It's aimed at ML researchers building physics-informed / PDE surrogate models who need large, diverse, standardized simulation data with a common dataset interface (WellDataset), streamable directly from Hugging Face or downloaded locally. Produced by Polymathic AI in collaboration with several universities and national labs, published at NeurIPS 2024.

use_cases.title: Train a PDE surrogate model on standardized physics data
Stream large physics simulation datasets from Hugging Face
Benchmark a new architecture against FNO baselines
Load fluid-dynamics or MHD simulation data into a training pipeline
